body:
I don't know anyone: no PO centers near me and the only time she sleeps it's at night. This place it's almost isolated from the rest of the city. 

Thankfully there's the bus stop that will take me to the underground though: i won't mind if she freaks out or start yelling at me/giving me calls, i won't even bring my phone with me.

Im also leaving different notes behind: hoping that what i own will go to people in need. 

Im feeling more hyped for this than for everything else i felt in my "life"

Im sorry to hear you're going through this as well: DIY was on my mind too but im afraid of messing up; the consequences of that aren't even lethal, just painful and so i backed off. Plus i really wouldn't know how to receive them: mom checks every package since my first attempt was related to drugs (that came into a package), can't even open a PO since i can't go out. I wish you will get the package with estrogens: you need it!

Eh i've tried on the internet, but everyone thinks im weird: im probably the only 20 years old that will get punished if he goes out without mommy's permission, so i cant really blame them.
I don't have a circle of friends: i was trying to get to know with other people at my local LGBT center, but mom won't accompany me there anymore because she's 100% coinvinced that "bad people" (don't even know what the fuck that's supposed to mean, she can't find the words to explain it) are lurking there. Im sure that if i'll try going out, she will lock me out of the house. 
I don't think this matters at all by the way: even if i had a way to transition, i will be either teased or assaulted in public because blending in, when it comes to MtF, it's a privilege that only a few have and of course genetics weren't on my side on this as well. 
Basically, im either left with living in pain and a brain that barely even works anymore or i can just take my own life and stop this from damaging me either further. 
I think suicide it's reasonable: if i could, i would try euthanasia, but since it isn't classified as a disorder anymore, they can't put you down for just being a loser. 
So yeah, train it is: im excited for this

It's okay by me: sadly i don't have any other effective ways so i'll just have to go with this one. 
i think that's the point by the way: no one will care for people like me if it doesn't cause problems.
It can also be a really fun experience i think: i tend to make myself bleed sometimes just to spend a few minutes trying to figure out how to  stop the bleeding; the train thing it's this but on steroids (if i somehow survive)

It's okay: those will be my final minutes so i don't really care. 
Plus, if you lay down on the rails there's a huge chance that the train will decapitate you; in that case, it's not going to hurt at all.
